title: Square-root bound for the reciprocal block count
statement: For every real $\delta$ with $0<\delta\le\tfrac12$, let $m=\lfloor\delta^{-1}\rfloor$. Then $\sqrt m/m\le\sqrt2\,\sqrt\delta$.
replaced:
For every real $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq1/2$, setting $m=\lfloor1/\delta\rfloor$ gives
\[
\frac{\sqrt m}{m}\leq\sqrt2\,\sqrt\delta.
\]
